name: Twin Isles
blurb: Two green islands face each other across open ocean. Each side flies from an island airfield or its carrier, with a volcanic peak beside every base and rocky islets in the strait.

name: Dune Sea
blurb: A sand sea of long dune ridges broken by flat-topped mesas, with a dry wadi winding across the line, a white salt flat, and a palm oasis by each airfield.

name: Iron Coast
blurb: A long green coastline runs between the two bases, with cliffs, beaches, a fjord and a harbour town. Both sides have a coastal airfield and a carrier group out at sea.

name: High Valley
blurb: Green valleys of farms, forest and lakes, split by a snow-capped range with one low pass. Fly the pass under the peaks, or climb over them.
